essence: The universal consecration is performed to secure sovereignty, fame, longevity, and health.
The Puṣya consecration should be performed annually in a sacred place.
All suffering for everyone may arise from the motion of the planets and similar causes.
After worship, the teacher should offer oblations together with the initiated.
One should worship the nine planets, including Rāhu and Ketu, each by its own name.
